{{NSE|DELTACORP}} | founded = {{start date and age|1985}} | area_served = Worldwide | key_people = Jaydev Mody (chairman) | industry = [[Casino industry|Casino]]
[[Hospitality industry|Hospitality]] | hq_location = Delta House, Hornby Vellard Estate, Dr. Annie Besant Road, Next to Copper Chimney, Worli, Mumbai – 400018 | hq_location_city = [[Pune]], [[Maharashtra]], India{{cite news |title=Pune's Delta Corp Ltd Forays into Online Gaming; Acquires Poker Site Adda.com For $27 Mn |url=https://inc42.com/flash-feed/adda-com-acquisition/ |access-date=25 May 2022 |work=Inc42 Media |date=1 September 2016 |language=en}} | revenue = {{increase}} {{INRconvert|1067|c}} (FY23) | net_income = {{increase}} {{INRconvert|261|c}} (FY23){{cite web |title=Delta Corp Ltd Q4FY23 consolidated PAT at Rs. 51.17 crores|url=https://www.equitybulls.com/category.php?id=330019 |publisher=Equity Bulls |access-date=12 July 2023}} | website = {{URL|http://www.deltacorp.in/}} }} '''Delta Corp Limited''', formerly Arrow Webtex Limited, is an Indian [[public company]] specializing in gaming and hospitality. The firm's primary assets encompass offshore [[Casino industry|casino]] and hospitality services, operating under the '''[[Deltin|Deltin Casinos & Hotels]]''' brand. The company engages in various forms of casino gaming, including live and electronic gaming, with a significant focus on operations in [[Goa]]. == History == Delta Corp Limited was initially established on 5 November 1985, as a [[privately held company]] known as Creole Holdings Company Private Limited. Following the acquisition of shares by the [[Finolex Group]], the company underwent a transition into a deemed [[public limited company]] and changed its name to Creole Holdings Company Ltd on 2 June 1992. During the period of 2003–04, Finolex Cables Limited divested its shareholdings, leading to the company no longer being a [[subsidiary]]. On 25 September 2003, the company was transformed into a private limited company.{{Cite web|url=https://www.edelweiss.in/stocks/delta-corp-ltd/company-history/17211.html|title=Delta Corp Ltd|website=Edelweiss|accessdate=23 February 2017}} In 2007, it was rebranded as Arrow Webtex Limited, and in 2008, it adopted its current name, Delta Corp Limited.{{Cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/delta-corp-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-9453.cms|title=Delta Corp Ltd.|website=The Economic Times|accessdate=23 February 2017}} == Divisions == === Offshore casinos and casino hotels === On 1 December 2015, Delta Corp Limited announced that it had been granted a license to operate a casino at its Deltin Suite hotel in Goa.{{Cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/delta-corp-inches-up-after-bagging-license-for-a-casino-in-goa-115120200240_1.html|title=Delta Corp inches up after bagging license for a casino in Goa|work=Business Standard|date=2 December 2015 |accessdate=8 September 2016}} Subsequently, the [[Government of Goa]] extended the company's offshore casino license to allow on the [[Mandovi River]], with annual renewals subject to license fees and compliance with government regulations.{{Cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/delta-corp-surges-as-goa-extends-offshore-casino-licenses/articleshow/51724400.cms|title=Delta Corp surges as Goa extends offshore casino licenses |work= The Economic Times|date=7 April 2016|accessdate=23 February 2017}} As of 2026, Delta Corp holds three of the six offshore gaming licenses issued in Goa and operates a land-based casino in Goa. Additionally, the company operates India's largest integrated five-star resort in [[Daman, Daman and Diu|Daman]], known as The Deltin{{Cite web |title=Delta Corp: Reports, Company History, Directors Report, Chairman's Speech, Auditors Report of Delta Corp |url=http://profit.ndtv.com/stock/delta-corp-ltd_deltacorp/reports |accessdate=8 September 2016 |website=profit.ndtv.com}} {{Cite web |title=Report of bonuses and offers |url=https://hclcolor.com/technology/what-bonuses-does-wild-fortune-casino-offer/ |website=hclcolor.com}} == See also == * [[Casino Goa]] * [[Deltin|Deltin Casinos & Hotels]] == References == {{reflist}} == External links == * [http://www.deltacorp.in/ Official website] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Hospitality companies]]
